name: DIALOG
recent: Dialog 近期在沙巴 Salbiah 气田投产，并宣布对 Fatimah 气田投资 2.11 亿美元，上游业务扩张成为焦点。同时，此外，EPF 与 KWAP 等主要机构股东在 10 月底至 11 月中持续申报持股变动。
notable: Salbiah 气田开始生产天然气。
公司宣布对 Fatimah 气田投资 2.11 亿美元。
risks: EPF 与 KWAP 在 10 月底至 11 月中多次申报持股变动，显示主要机构股东持仓持续调整。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 7.7456 亿令吉，环比增长 11.2%，同比增长 27.3%；净利为 1.6747 亿令吉，环比增长 12.9%，同比增长 13.6%；净利率为 21.6%，高于上一季度的 21.3%。

recent_en: Dialog recently started gas production at the Salbiah field in Sabah and announced a US$211 million investment in the Fatimah field, with upstream expansion in focus. It also withdrew a proposed share option scheme for the CEO. Meanwhile, major institutional shareholders such as EPF and KWAP continued to file changes in their shareholdings from late October to mid-November.
notable_en: Gas production commenced at the Salbiah field.
The company announced a US$211 million investment in the Fatimah field.
The company withdrew the proposed share option scheme for CEO Mustaffa Kamal.
risks_en: EPF and KWAP filed multiple changes in shareholdings from late October to mid-November, indicating ongoing position adjustments by major institutional shareholders.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 774.56 million, up 11.2% QoQ and 27.3% YoY; net income was MYR 167.47 million, up 12.9% QoQ and 13.6% YoY; net margin was 21.6%, higher than 21.3% in the previous quarter.
